parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue of missing error formatting in subparsers by ensuring that relevant arguments are copied through to constructed subparsers. The changes are minimal and focused on the problem area.

issues.description: The patch introduces new methods and attributes to the CommandParser class, which could slightly increase the complexity of the code. However, this is a necessary change to fix the issue.
